name: Text2GraphQuery-Bench
description: Graph models are fundamental to data analysis in domains rich with complex relationships. Unlike SQL, which benefits from a rel- atively unified standard and widespread familiarity, graph query languages are diverse (e.g., Cypher, GQL, SQL/PGQ) and far less fa- miliar to most users, making them significantly harder to learn and use. Text-to-Graph-Query systems address this barrier by trans- lating natural language into executable graph queries, enabling LLMs to serve as interfaces for Graph Database Management Systems (GDBMS).
